notes: The owner's words: *"Currently on the Cohorts page you have dozens of notes and warnings displayed. That obscures the primary purpose of the page. From a user interface design perspective what should happen is that an icon should be displayed that indicates that warnings exist. The user then can click on that icon and see a popup that displays the warnings and notifications, in this way it won't overwhelm the display."* He was right, and the remedy has a trap in it. This house's first law is disclosure, and 5.0.0 exists precisely because a cohort list was read on 2026-08-05 showing twelve name
